Before you choose

A few useful answers.

WhatsApp connection: US$19/month optional on Essentials; included in Core, Build and Scale. Billable messages are separate.

What happens after the Essentials trial?

A card is required to start the 7-day trial. It converts automatically to Essentials at US$99/month unless you cancel before the trial ends. The trial includes the Start Here page and video library. Guided setup hours begin with the paid plan.

How are Build responses counted?

Build includes 1,000 AI replies each month, shared across web chat, Instagram DMs, Facebook DMs and WhatsApp messaging. Each AI reply counts as one response. Five AI replies use five responses. At signup, choose to pause AI at the limit or continue at US$0.028 per additional response.

Which plan includes voice AI?

Scale includes voice conversations on your website chat widget and WhatsApp calls. Text responses and voice minutes are unlimited under fair use. Build includes text AI across four channels and has no Voice AI minutes.

What is billed separately?

Email delivery and billable WhatsApp messages are charged on use. Optional add-ons, premium workflow actions and your payment processor fees are separate. We confirm applicable usage charges before activation.

Can I set things up myself?

Yes. Configure supported features yourself or use your first-month guided setup allowance. Additional channels, integrations, data cleanup or bespoke workflows need an agreed scope. Extra support is US$250 for a 5-hour block; scope and block terms are agreed before purchase.
